videoDetails.title: When should you NOT use /grill-me?
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Learn when to use the /grill-me skill and when to just dive right in. In this video, I break down a decision tree for choosing between one-shotting small changes, using a grilling session for medium work, and leveraging Wayfinder for large-scale projects.
